role-play a hostile financial regulator questioning our backtest
teach a five-year-old what a p-value is
design a closing ritual for the end of a two-week sprint
invent a name for a color nobody has seen
analyse a dream log for recurring symbols
write a haiku that is also a valid regular expression
make a board game out of our test suite

find the funniest bug report in our history
